title: Choose the simplified expiry editor
question: All three keep Material 3, OCR source-versus-confirmed values, quantity per expiry, and an expandable totals/save footer. Choose one or steer a final combination.

options.label: Invoice context + inline splits
options.lineage: B header and line list + C evidence table
options.thesis: Keep three invoice lines visible, then edit the selected line's commercial values and all expiry quantities together.
options.viewport: The operator sees neighboring items, four confirmed values, and every expiry split in one continuous page.
options.risk: It is the longest and densest of the three choices.

options.label: One expiry at a time
options.lineage: B header + expiry tabs + C evidence table
options.thesis: Keep invoice context while editing one clearly selected expiry row at a time, with an explicit apply-to-all choice.
options.viewport: The selected expiry's quantity, date, and four commercial values remain together.
options.risk: Users must understand the expiry tabs and the apply-to-all checkbox.

options.label: Simple previous / next
options.lineage: B review header + C evidence editor with progressive disclosure
options.thesis: Show one item at a time with plain previous/next navigation, then prices and expiry rows in two simple sections.
options.viewport: The operator follows one linear task without a competing invoice-line list.
options.risk: Neighboring invoice items are no longer visible by name while editing.
